events.longDescription: To the Esteemed Masters of the College, I write at the urging of several concerned townsfolk regarding a matter we are ill-equipped to resolve. A local child, Ingrid, daughter of the late Hrolf, has been claiming with increasing insistence that she sees her father standing outside her window at night. The man was buried a month past, and no one has seen anything amiss. Most believe the girl is simply struggling with her grief. Still, her stories have become persistent, detailed, and disruptive. She refuses to sleep, speaks of footsteps where none are found, and has begun frightening other children. It is unsettling the village, and we would prefer the matter settled. If this is nothing, we ask that you put the child’s fears to rest. Forget the dark hallways; you’re trapped on a tin roof in the blistering sun. Forget the goblins; you’re up against prehistoric creatures that hunt by sound. If you walk on the sand, you’re a snack. If you scream, you’re a target. If you have a plan involving homemade pipe bombs and a pogo stick? Well, now you’re talking.  Pre made characters will be provided for this loving homage to the American cinema classic "Tremors".
